day_local: Talaadada Toddobaadka Labaatan iyo Shanaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, jacaylka Ilaah, iyo wada-jirka Ruuxa Quduuska ah ha idinla jiraan.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
homily:
Waxaa jira sawir yar oo maanta maskaxdayda ku soo dhacaya, sawir aan ka duwanayn xusuusta qoyska ee maalin qorrax leh. Waxaan arkaa Ben oo taagan meel bannaan oo ballaadhan, isagoo eegaya cirka oo ay ku dul wareegayaan daruuro jilicsan, isagoo xidhan koofiyaddiisa baseball-ka ee midabka guduudan. Wuxuu u muuqdaa mid neefsanaya, mid si dhab ah u qaadanaya dunida ku xeeran. Wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay inuu joogsado si uu u fiirsado; wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay inuu arko waxa ka dambeeya waxa indhaha saaran. Maanta, akhriska koowaad wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in 'qorshayaasha dadka ay u muuqan karaan kuwo sax ah indhahooda, laakiin Rabbiga ayaa ah kan tijaabiya qalbiyada.' 

Waxaan inta badan isku daynaa inaan qorshayno nolosheenna, sida Ben oo si taxaddar leh u dhisayay koodhka kumbuyuutarka ama uu u qorshaynayay mustaqbalkiisa 'Con Chim Airlines'. Waxaan rabnaa inaan xakameyno, inaan xisaabino, inaan saadaalinno. Laakiin mararka qaarkood, nolosha ayaa inoo keenta wax aynaan qorshayn. Waxay inoo keentaa xanuun aan la filayn, aamusnaan guriga dhexdiisa ah, iyo kursi mar walba madhan. Waxaan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ay idinku noqdeen kuwo culus oo aamusnaan ka buuxdo, Alan iyo Thao. Waxaan ogahay in habeenkii, marka aad eegto sawirrada Ben ee uu ku jiro dhoolacaddayntiisa quruxda badan, aad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Maxaynu seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan maanta dhex fadhiisto xanuunkaas idinkala socda oo aan idiin sheego si cad: Waxba ma aad seegin. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Xanuunka iyo dhimashada aan la fileynin ee soo martay Ben ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise ugu jawaabay markii la weydiiyay sababta uu ninku u dhashay indhoolaha: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Jacaylka aad Ben siisateen—sheekooyinkii Alan, xanaanadii Thao—wuxuu ahaa nuurka dhabta ah ee noloshiisa. 

Injiilka maanta wuxuu inoo sheegayaa wax aad u cajiib ah. Ciise waxaa loo sheegay in hooyadiis iyo walaalihiis ay bannaanka taagan yihiin. Dad badan ayaa laga yaabaa inay yidhaahdaan, 'Ciise, waa qoyskaaga, u bax oo la kulan.' Laakiin Ciise wuxuu yidhi: 'Hooyaday iyo walaalahay waa kuwa maqla ereyga Ilaah oo ku dhaqma.' Halkan, Ciise ma diidayo qoyskiisa; wuxuu ballaadhinayaa macnaha qoyska. Wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in xidhiidhka dhabta ah ee aynu la leennahay Ilaah uu ka xoog badan yahay dhimashada, ka xoog badan yahay kala fogaanshaha. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil 'maqla ereyga Ilaah oo ku dhaqma.' Wuxuu ku dhaqmay jacaylkiisa markii uu u soo bandhigay inuu bixiyo lacagtiisa si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas safka hore kaga jiray ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa xigmadda dhabta ah ee Masiixu inoo sheegayo. Ben wuxuu baray qoyskiisa in jacaylku aanu ahayn waxa aad haysato, laakiin waa waxa aad diyaar u tahay inaad bixiso. 

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in dunidaadu ay isbeddeshay. Waxaan ogahay in kursiga agtaada ah uu mararka qaarkood u muuqdo mid madhan. Laakiin xusuuso, Ben wuxuu kula joogaa jacaylka aad u hayso. Sida uu kuugu sheegay riyadaada, halkaas oo aad ku wada raacdeen 'roller coaster', xidhiidhka idinka dhexeeya wuu sii socdaa. Ha ka cabsan inaad noolaato, ha ka cabsan inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdo. 

Waxaan rabaa inaan idinku dhiirrigeliyo inaad u oggolaataan in naxariista Ilaah ay bogsiiso qalbiyadiinna. Ha isku dayin inaad xalliso xanuunkaaga adigoo isticmaalaya xisaabtaada. Ha isku dayin inaad fahanto sababta uu Ben u baxay. Kaliya u dhiib qalbigaaga Ciise. U oggolow inuu kula fadhiisto, kula cuno, oo kula qaybsado xanuunkaaga. Ciise ma aha mid iska fogeeya kuwa murugaysan; wuxuu u yimid inuu la fadhiisto. Wuxuu rabaa inuu noqdo dhakhtarkaaga maanta. 

Markaad ka baxaysaan meeshan maanta, qaado hal shay oo yar: Ha ku tiirsanaan xigmaddaada marka culaysku yimaado. U dhiib qalbigaaga Ciise. Ha joojiso inaad is-eedeyso. Ogow in Ben uu ku jiro nabadda iyo gacmaha Aabbaha, oo uu halkaas idinku sugayo. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay meel nabdoon, wuxuuna idin leeyahay: 'Haku murugoonina si xad dhaaf ah; waan idin daawanayaa.' Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa jeclahay wax walba, waxaanan rabaa inaan naftayda ku qaato. Maadaama aanan hadda si dhab ah kuu qaadan karin, fadlan qalbigayga ku soo gal si ruuxi ah. Waxaan ku duubayaa sidii adigoo horey u joogay, waxaanan naftayda u hurayaa adiga. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idinku barakeeyo oo ha idin ilaaliyo, wejigiisuna ha idin iftiimiyo. Nabadgelyo.
standing_petitions: Waxaan u duceynaynaa wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay ee dhintay, inuu Rabbigu siiyo nasasho weligeed ah iyo iftiinka wejigiisa.
Waxaan u duceynaynaa dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, gaar ahaan qoyska Alan iyo Thao, inuu Ilaah siiyo naxariis, rajo, iyo xoog ay ku sii wataan nolosha.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Sida durdurka oo kale ayaa wadnaha boqorka gacanta Rabbiga ugu jiraa; meeshuu doonona wuu u leexiyaa. Jid kasta oo nin u muuqdaa waa mid toosan indhihiisa, laakiin Rabbiga ayaa ah kan tijaabiya qalbiyada. In la sameeyo waxa xaqa ah iyo waxa cadaalada ah ayaa Rabbiga uga roon allabari. Indho kibir badan iyo qalbi isla weyn—beerashada kuwa sharka leh waa dembi. Qorshayaasha qofka dadaalaya ayaa hubaal faa'iido u keena, laakiin degdegga badan ayaa hubaal u horseeda saboolnimo. Qof kasta oo hanti ku sameeya carrab been ah waa mid cayrsanaya xumbo dabinno dhimasho leh. Nafta ninka sharka leh waxay rabtaa shar; deriskiisu naxariis kama helo indhihiisa. Marka ninka kibirka badan la ciqaabo, kuwa fudud ayaa xikmad yeesha; marka ninka xikmad leh la baro, wuxuu helaa aqoon. Ninka xaqa ah wuxuu qiimeeyaa guriga kuwa sharka leh: waxaa jira mid u horseeda kuwa sharka leh burbur. Qofka dhegaha ka xidha qaylada saboolka, isaga qudhiisu wuu qaylin doonaa, mana la maqli doono.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. I mari, Rabbiyow, jidka amarradaada. Barakaysan yihiin kuwa jidkoodu yahay mid aan eed lahayn, kuwa ku socda sharciga Rabbiga. R. I mari, Rabbiyow, jidka amarradaada. I fahamsii jidka qaynuunnadaada, oo waxaan ka fikiri doonaa shuqulladaada yaabka leh. R. I mari, Rabbiyow, jidka amarradaada. Jidka runta ayaan doortay; waxaan hor dhigay amarradaada. R. I mari, Rabbiyow, jidka amarradaada. I sii garasho, si aan u dhawro sharcigaaga oo aan u xajisto qalbigayga oo dhan. R. I mari, Rabbiyow, jidka amarradaada. I mari jidka amarradaada, waayo waxaan ku raaxaystaa. R. I mari, Rabbiyow, jidka amarradaada. Oo waxaan xajin doonaa sharcigaaga had iyo goor, weligii iyo weligiisba. R. I mari, Rabbiyow, jidka amarradaada.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Hooyadii Ciise iyo walaalihiis ayaa u yimid, laakiin ma ay awoodin inay u soo dhowaadaan dadkii badnaa darteed. Waxaa loo sheegay, 'Hooyadaa iyo walaalahaa ayaa bannaanka taagan, waxayna rabaan inay ku arkaan.' Wuxuu u jawaabay oo ku yidhi, 'Hooyaday iyo walaalahay waa kuwa maqla ereyga Ilaah oo ku dhaqma.'

day: Tuesday of the Twenty-fifth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm
